paragraphs.text: Yinglong is an ancient dragon on the plane of Shenmeng .

In the rich and vibrant world of Shenmeng , Yinglong stands as a symbol of creation and life, revered by all who inhabit this mythical realm. Its legacy as the Ancestor Dragon continues to inspire and protect, embodying the timeless connection between the plane's mythical creatures and the natural world.

As the Ancestor Dragon, Yinglong holds a significant place in the mythology of Shenmeng. According to legends, Yinglong is the progenitor of many mystical creatures, including the qilin and the phoenix . These creatures, in turn, are believed to be the ancestors of all hairy and winged beings in the world. This legendary status underscores Yinglong's importance and reverence among the inhabitants of Shenmeng.

Yinglong is depicted as a majestic dragon with the power of flight, symbolizing its dominion over the skies. Its presence on the battlefield brings not only awe but also tangible benefits to its allies, showcasing its protective and nurturing nature.
